name: Canvas status
summary: The status line and response count on a slide canvas (Waiting for answers… · 8 of 24 answered) as one component: free-floating deck text, no fill on any deck.
highlights: Status line over the response count, centred
Free-floating text in the deck ink, no backing even on photo decks
A polite live region that announces each new count once
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-canvas-status> — for the waiting state many slide types show on the presenter canvas before the result: a status line in the deck ink at 76% and, under it, a people glyph and "8 of 24 answered" in the deck ink. It carries no fill or stroke, so it sits straight on the deck, a photo deck included. Text and counts are attributes; pass translated strings in the product.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. Attributes only, no events.

spec.label: Status line
spec.value: 18px / 400 (the canvas body size), --aha-deck-ink-secondary (the deck ink at 76%); `text=""` hides it

spec.label: Count
spec.value: system-users 24 · 4px · "8 of 24 answered" 20px / 600, tabular figures, in the deck ink; hidden while `answered` is unset

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: column, centred, 12px between line and count

spec.label: Backing
spec.value: none on every deck — never a fill, stroke or scrim, photo decks included

props.name: text
props.desc: The status line; an empty string hides it

props.name: answered
props.desc: How many answered; unset hides the count

props.name: total
props.desc: How many can answer; with it the count reads "8 of 24 answered", without it "8 answered"

props.name: count-text
props.desc: Replaces the count sentence; pass a translated string in the product

whenToUse.when: while answers come in on the presenter canvas: what is happening and how many answered
once there is a result to count: correct / incorrect, or answered next to the result

opinion.note: Keep it to the line and the count. It is text on the deck, so never put it in a card or behind a scrim: on a photo deck the deck's own text treatment carries it, as it carries the slide title.

a11y.role: role="status" with aria-live="polite"; the glyph is decorative
a11y.note: Updates change the text of persistent nodes, so a screen reader hears each new count once and nothing is re-announced on unrelated renders.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The probe sits on a white stage with no deck applied, so every value is its DS fallback.

selfCheck.label: no fill, stroke or scrim on any deck
line in the deck ink at 76%, count in the deck ink
polite live region updated on persistent nodes
